text: After sawing the fallen rafter through (tick ~4290), the checklist 'Haul out the debris' count went UP from 15 left to 17 left: the rafter (counted as 1) became 3 pieces. Progress counter going backwards after finishing a task feels like a setback; no message explains it.

CORRECTION to debris_up: the game did show a status line at tick 4217 ('Sawn into three lengths... three pieces to haul out instead of one'), so the 15->17 rise is explained, though the message is brief and easy to miss at low fps. Sawing took ~11 s of hold (ticks ~3770-4217 incl. a release); progress held at 6%->12% across a release, it does not reset.
Positive: swept floor is visibly lighter wood and unswept is dark and speckled with leaves, so you can see from a distance which parts of the floor are still dirty (tick ~23100, floor 49%).

Walls: after scrubbing ~25 s at the corner near (-3.65, 3.83) (walls 13%->17%), stepping back I cannot tell which logs are clean and which are grimy; up close the wall is uniform dark brown, and by 3:30 pm the cabin interior is very dark. Unlike the floor and chimney, the walls give little visual sign of what is left. Only the per-spot meter ('Clean here. Move on.') tells you.

Sweep the floor: 0->89% took ~3 min of sweeping, but the last 7% stalled (89->92->93% over ~2 more passes, ticks 28600-30357). Leftover dirt is in corners and along walls/under the hearth area, and in the dimming afternoon light (2:30 pm on) dirty patches become hard to spot. No hint where the remaining dirt is.
